Our Services

Comprehensive Care for Every Stage of Life

Professional family healthcare services designed around your needs. Specific treatment and procedures are provided following clinical assessment.

✚

General Family Medicine

Comprehensive care for individuals and families of all ages.

Assessment, diagnosis and ongoing family healthcare.
♥

Children’s Health

Growth monitoring, immunisations and management of common childhood illnesses.

Child health support and guidance for parents.
♀

Women’s Health

Personalised care through every stage of life.

Women’s health, reproductive health and family-planning guidance.
❤

Chronic Disease Management

Ongoing care for conditions such as diabetes, hypertension and other long-term conditions.

Monitoring, treatment support and lifestyle guidance.
✓

Preventive Care & Screening

Early detection and health screening to support a healthier future.

Health checks, blood pressure, cholesterol and lifestyle advice.
✚

Minor Procedures

Wound care, stitching, dressing changes and other minor treatments.

Provided following clinical assessment by the doctor.
About Twin Peaks

Family-focused care, close to home.

Twin Peaks Family Practice is a patient-focused medical practice in Rehoboth, Namibia. We aim to provide high-quality, compassionate and comprehensive healthcare for individuals and families.

Family FocusedCare for children, adults and families.
Professional CareRespectful, patient-centred consultations.
PreventionSupport for healthier choices and early detection.
